primary_variables.matched_definition: Fallback category for studies where no clear perturbation or differential treatment axis is present in the proteomics comparison. This is not a mapping error when supported by evidence.
evidence: We designed a peptide internal standard-based assay directed toward sample preparation strategies for mass spectrometry analysis to understand better phosphopeptide recovery from enrichment strategies.

As proof-of-principle, we compared three enrichment methods using the mTMT/phos9 recovery assay: two Fe-NTA (nitrilotriacetic acid)-based IMAC (immobilized metal affinity chromatography) protocols and one TiO2-based MOAC (metal oxide affinity chromatography) protocol.

replicate_hints: subjected 1 mg aliquots of human whole cell lysate to three phosphopeptide enrichment strategies in triplicate
multiplex_channel_hints: mass-differential tandem mass tag (mTMT) reagents (specifically, TMTzero and TMTsuper-heavy)

evidence: The recovery of the phos9 peptides was on average 78.3 ± 7% for IMAC1 (High-Select), 56.8 ± 18% for IMAC2 (Fe-NTA) and 22.9 ± 16% for TiO2.
